the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: dimension at a point is invariant under base change (02FY), so one may extend the ground field until two given points are rational, and translation gives an automorphism carrying one to the other, whence equal dimensions; the local formula (02FX) splits dim_g into the local ring dimension plus the transcendence degree of kappa(g); the global dimension is the supremum of local dimensions (02IZ), maximal at closed points where the transcendence degree vanishes (Nullstellensatz, 01T9), giving equidimensionality and the closed-point formula (source lines 1458-1477)
